title: caesalpinia scortechinii
intro: Caesalpinia scortechinii, commonly known as the Bunga Keladi or Bunga Kantan, is a plant species within the Caesalpinia genus. It is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, contributing to the plant's potential health benefits.
